sentences.text: This marine reptile possessed fine, needle-like sharp teeth similar to those of nothosaurs, likely used to trap small prey like fish and squids.
An opalized partial skeleton was found in an opal mine in the Bulldog Shale at Andamooka, South Australia, and described by Kear in 2006.
Opallionectes is classified within the family Cryptoclididae.
Opallionectes lived during the Aptian stage, between 119.57 and 113.2 million years ago.
